An uncensored DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 model is claimed to run locally on consumer hardware with a 12GB GPU, while refusals reportedly fell from 85% to 0% on JailbreakBench—even during reasoning. The post says routed experts remained byte-identical, GPQA performance was unchanged and AIME performance slightly improved.

It says the model runs through Strata with 64GB of RAM and SSD offload. A separate post says Unsloth Dynamic V3.1 leads other frontier quantisations across benchmarks including GPQA Diamond, AIME25, LiveCodeBench, MMLU-Pro and Aider, with local operation requiring 64GB or more of RAM.

The downloadable build is a 552B-parameter GGUF listed by AtomicChat on Hugging Face. Its listing describes a single 12GB GPU setup with a large Engram table streamed from SSD. The original post says the Strata setup uses 64GB of RAM and SSD offload; Strata's model guide separately lists 12GB VRAM and 64GB system RAM for large local models. The post's 85%-to-0% refusal figure and benchmark results are the poster's reported tests, not independently verified here.
